$comment: Source of truth for docs/ART_ASSET_REQUIREMENTS.md (tables are generated: pnpm art:doc). Sizes: 'display' is the size the code draws today in logical px (game px on the 1280x720 board, CSS px in the UI). Exports are @2x and @3x of display unless stated. Every asset inherits its category defaults; any field set on the asset overrides them.

defaults.format: WebP (lossy q90) for opaque surfaces; PNG-32 for parts with transparency
defaults.productionNotes: Top-down orthographic view, no perspective. Lighting from the top-left at 45°, soft. Keep the playable area readable: markings must stay ≥ 60% contrast against the grass at 1x.
defaults.acceptance: Matches the stated pixel size exactly; aligns with the physics geometry in packages/config/data/physics.json (1 unit = 66 game px); no baked-in UI text.

assets.name: Stadium background
assets.purpose: Fills the whole board canvas behind the pitch (stands, floodlit night stadium, crowd silhouettes). Letterbox areas on wide screens show the page background, so the edges should fade to the page colour #0b1226.
assets.notes: Keep the central 1190×630 area calm (the pitch covers it). Edges carry the theme identity.
assets.acceptanceExtra: Edge pixels within ±6 of #0b1226 so the letterbox seam is invisible.

assets.name: Pitch surface with markings
assets.purpose: Playable grass surface: stripes plus all markings (touchlines, halfway line, centre circle r=85.8, centre spot r=4, penalty boxes 145×317, goal boxes 59×211).
assets.variants: park (grass), city (rooftop turf), coast (sand-edge turf), capital (premium stadium grass), legends (night/gold)
assets.notes: Marking geometry must match exactly (it is drawn in code today; see MatchScene.drawPitch). Lines 3 px at 1x, colour close to #eaf7ee at 85% opacity.
assets.acceptanceExtra: Overlaying the procedural placeholder at 50% shows no line misalignment > 1 px at 1x.

assets.name: Pitch frame / boards
assets.purpose: Raised rounded border around the pitch (the walls the discs bounce off).
assets.display: 1026×630 at x 127, y 45; corner radius 22; inner edge = pitch edge
assets.placeholder: Placeholder: navy rounded rectangle with 3 px edge
assets.notes: The inner edge is the physical wall: art must not intrude into the pitch area (discs touch it).

assets.name: Goal (posts, crossbar seen from above, pocket floor)
assets.purpose: Goal pocket behind each goal line. One asset, mirrored for the right side.
assets.display: 66×172 pocket + 8 px post bleed → 80×184 file at 1x; left pocket at x 79–145, y 274–446
assets.placeholder: Placeholder: dark rectangle + 9 px net grid + white stroke
assets.acceptanceExtra: Opening faces right in the source file; posts sit exactly on the pitch edge.

assets.name: Goal net texture
assets.purpose: Tileable net mesh inside the goal pocket; used by the goal ripple effect (FX-NET).

assets.name: Team side banners
assets.purpose: Vertical team-colour panels outside each goal; tinted at runtime with the team primary colour.
assets.notes: Greyscale so one file serves all teams via tint.

defaults.format: PNG-32 (packed into a texture atlas, see §6)
defaults.layer: Discs depth 10, ball depth 11, shadows below discs
defaults.productionNotes: Seen exactly from above. Bodies do not rotate in play (rotation is locked in physics), so do not rely on rotation to read as spin. Keep a 2 px transparent margin.
defaults.acceptance: Circle diameter matches the physics radius exactly (disc 0.42 u, ball 0.22 u); reads clearly at 1x on both grass colours.

assets.name: Team disc
assets.purpose: Player piece. Bottle-cap / tabletop counter with a team emblem in the centre.
assets.screens: F-07 Match, F-03 Tutorial, shop/locker thumbnails (via THB-TEAM)
assets.variants: team_volt, team_coral, team_ocean, team_sunset, team_royal, team_forest (colours in packages/config/data/cosmetics.json)
assets.notes: Outer ring = team secondary colour, face = primary, emblem = secondary. Add a subtle bevel/specular so discs read as objects.
assets.acceptanceExtra: Opaque circle edge within 1 px of 55.4 px at 1x; the two default teams (volt vs coral) stay distinguishable in greyscale and for deuteranopia.

assets.name: Ball
assets.purpose: The ball.
assets.screens: F-07 Match, F-03 Tutorial, boot spinner, shop/locker
assets.acceptanceExtra: Readable against every pitch theme at 1x; never confusable with a disc.

assets.name: Contact shadows
assets.purpose: Soft shadow under each disc and the ball, offset +4,+6.
assets.notes: Black with alpha only (no colour), so it works on every pitch.

assets.name: Turn highlight ring
assets.purpose: Glow ring around every disc of the side to move (pulses).
assets.quantity: 1 (tinted: lime for my turn, white 35% for opponent)
assets.animation: Pulse handled in code (alpha 0.55–0.9, 1.4 s); optional 8-frame glow sheet

assets.name: Aim indicator set
assets.purpose: While dragging: power ring around the disc, direction arrow (shaft + head), dotted guide line.
assets.variants: power ring (88×88), arrow head (32×28), arrow shaft (8 px wide, 3-slice), guide dot (10×4)
assets.display: See variants; arrow length is 30–180 px depending on power
assets.format: PNG-32, white (tinted lime → coral by power at runtime)

defaults.format: PNG-32 sprite sheet (horizontal strip) + JSON frame data
defaults.productionNotes: Effects are disabled when Settings → Reduce motion is on, and with Graphics: Battery saver. Never put essential information only in an effect.
defaults.acceptance: Plays correctly at 30 fps; total sheet ≤ 512 KB at @2x; readable on all pitch themes.

assets.name: Collision spark
assets.purpose: Short burst where two pieces collide or a piece hits a wall.
assets.placeholder: Placeholder: white circle scaling ×3 and fading (220 ms)

assets.name: Ball trail
assets.purpose: Fading trail behind a fast ball.

assets.name: Goal celebration
assets.purpose: Confetti pieces in the scoring team's colours plus a goal-mouth flash.
assets.variants: 3 confetti shapes (8×14 rectangle, 10×10 circle, 12×12 star; white, tinted at runtime), 1 goal flash (240×240, 8 frames)

assets.name: Net ripple
assets.purpose: Net bulges when the ball enters the goal.

categories.title: C1. Match HUD and match feedback

defaults.productionNotes: Text is never baked into images (the game ships in English and Persian/RTL). Banners are frames around live text.
defaults.acceptance: Works in LTR and RTL; no text in the image; legible at 375 px wide phones.

assets.name: Match banner frames
assets.purpose: Frame behind the GOAL!/own-goal, sudden-death, 'score 2 goals to win' and reconnecting messages.
assets.slicing: 9-slice (SVG with stretchable middle, or CSS border-image: 48 px caps)

assets.name: VS emblem
assets.purpose: Centre emblem between the two player cards while matchmaking.
assets.notes: Must work without the letters (the letters stay as live text for localisation) or use language-neutral shapes.

assets.name: Searching-opponent placeholder
assets.purpose: Opponent slot while searching (pulses).

assets.name: Level-up badge and burst
assets.purpose: Shown on the result screen when the server reports a new level.
assets.variants: badge (120×120, level number stays live text), burst (240×240, 12 frames)

assets.name: Victory / defeat headers
assets.purpose: Decorative header art behind the live 'Victory!' / 'Defeat' text.

assets.name: Tutorial illustrations
assets.purpose: One illustration per tutorial step: press a glowing disc, drag back, release to shoot.
assets.notes: Show a hand/finger and a mouse cursor variant, or a neutral pointer. Directions must not depend on reading direction.

defaults.format: SVG (24×24 viewBox, 2 px stroke, round caps/joins, currentColor)
defaults.states: Default (colour comes from CSS: muted #a9b4d6, active #c6ff3d, text #f4f7ff)
defaults.productionNotes: One consistent family: same stroke weight, corner radius and optical size. No emoji. Icons that imply direction (back) are mirrored by CSS in RTL, so draw them for LTR.
defaults.acceptance: Uses currentColor only; pixel-crisp at 14, 16, 18, 22 and 40 px; passes SVGO without visual change.

assets.name: Navigation icons
assets.purpose: Bottom navigation (mobile) / side rail (desktop).

assets.name: Action and status icons
assets.purpose: Buttons, headers, states and badges.
assets.variants: back, close, play, pause, check, lock, robot (bot badge), users (2 players), globe (online), history, gift (rewards), wallet, info, offline, school (tutorial), bolt

assets.name: Currency icons
assets.purpose: Coins (soft currency) and gems (premium currency) in pills, prices and rewards.
assets.screens: Top bar, shop, rewards, arenas, result, history
assets.acceptanceExtra: Recognisable at 16 px; coin and gem differ in shape, not only colour.

assets.name: Team emblems
assets.purpose: Emblem shapes used on discs (PCS-DISC) and team swatches.
assets.variants: bolt, star, wave, sun, crown, leaf

assets.name: Player avatars
assets.purpose: Profile picture in the top bar, HUD, result, matchmaking and profile.
assets.display: 34, 44, 48, 56, 64, 72, 84 (square, 12–14 px corner radius applied by CSS)
assets.notes: Original characters, friendly sporty style. The bot must read as a robot at 34 px (players must always know they face a bot).
assets.acceptanceExtra: Readable at 34 px; full-bleed square (frame comes from UI-FRAME).

assets.name: Avatar frames
assets.purpose: Ring/frame around avatars: level frame (own profile) and bot frame.
assets.slicing: 9-slice (12 px corners) so one frame fits every avatar size

assets.name: FlickKick logo
assets.purpose: Wordmark in the top bar and large on boot/welcome; compact mark for small spaces.
assets.screens: F-01 Boot, F-02 Welcome, shell top bar
assets.format: SVG (outlined text), full colour + single-colour version
assets.notes: The name stays Latin in both languages. Must not resemble any existing football game's logo.
assets.acceptanceExtra: Legible at 24 px height; works on #0e1630 and on white.

assets.name: Loading indicator
assets.purpose: Bouncing ball shown while loading physics, joining matches and searching.

assets.name: Home mode-card illustrations
assets.purpose: Illustrations for the three home cards: Play online, Play vs AI, 2 players 1 device.

assets.name: Arena card art
assets.purpose: Header art for each arena in arena selection.

assets.name: Empty and error state illustrations
assets.purpose: Replace the generic 72 px icon in empty/error/offline states.
assets.screens: History (empty), wallet (empty), not found, server not connected / offline, generic error
assets.placeholder: Placeholder: line icon in a circle

defaults.states: Default; owned/equipped/locked are drawn by CSS
defaults.productionNotes: Thumbnails are shown on a navy card (#18234a). Centre the subject with 8% padding. One consistent light direction across all thumbnails.
defaults.acceptance: Item is recognisable at 56 px; consistent padding and lighting across the set.

assets.name: Team thumbnails
assets.purpose: Team (disc skin) items in shop and locker.
assets.screens: F-13 Shop, F-14 Locker, F-08 Play vs AI
assets.variants: team_volt, team_coral, team_ocean, team_sunset, team_royal, team_forest
assets.dependsOn: PCS-DISC (a 3/4 view render of the same disc is ideal)

assets.name: Ball thumbnails
assets.purpose: Ball skin items.

assets.name: Currency pack art
assets.purpose: Coin/gem packs in the shop's Coins & gems tab (sandbox until a payment provider is approved).

assets.name: Reward piles
assets.purpose: Daily-reward tiles (days 1–7), rewarded-ad bonus and level rewards.

assets.name: Rank badges (planned, M9 leaderboards)
assets.purpose: Tier badges next to leaderboard entries and on the profile.
assets.notes: Tier is also shown as live text, never by colour alone.

categories.title: F. App icon, web and store assets

defaults.transparency: Icons: no for maskable/apple; favicon SVG may be transparent
defaults.naming: As listed (fixed names expected by browsers)
defaults.productionNotes: The deployment target is the web (desktop + mobile browsers, installable PWA). No native store listing is planned in Phase 1.
defaults.acceptance: Exact pixel sizes; maskable icon keeps the mark inside the central 80% safe zone; passes Lighthouse PWA icon checks.

assets.name: App icon set
assets.purpose: Browser tab, home-screen and PWA install icons.
assets.variants: favicon.svg, favicon-32.png (32×32), apple-touch-icon.png (180×180), icon-192.png, icon-512.png, icon-maskable-512.png

assets.name: Social sharing image
assets.purpose: Open Graph / Twitter card image when the game URL is shared.
assets.notes: Text allowed here (this is marketing, one file per language).

assets.name: Promotional banners and screenshots
assets.purpose: Website/social promotion and any future store listing.
assets.variants: banners 1920×1080, 1080×1080, 1080×1920, 1200×300; screenshots captured from the final build (desktop 1920×1080, phone 2340×1080 landscape)
assets.dependsOn: All P0/P1 art (screenshots must show final art)

defaults.format: OGG Opus 96 kbps + MP3 128 kbps fallback (Safari), 48 kHz
defaults.loudness: SFX peaks ≤ −3 dBFS, short and dry; music −16 LUFS integrated, seamless loop points

assets.name: UI tap / disc pick-up
assets.trigger: audio.play('tap'): pressing an own disc; volume slider preview

assets.name: Invalid action / timeout
assets.trigger: audio.play('error'): opponent disc pressed, turn timed out

assets.name: Opponent found
assets.trigger: Matchmaking: opponent or bot assigned (to be wired)

assets.name: Turn timer warning
assets.trigger: Last 5 s of a turn (to be wired)

assets.name: Level up
assets.trigger: Result screen when the server reports a new level (to be wired)

assets.name: Match ambience (crowd bed)
assets.trigger: During matches, under SFX (to be wired)
